subject.title: fix(doctor): bound AGENTS.md and root-memory file reads

question: Should doctor intentionally stop automatic root-memory repair when either file exceeds 8 MiB, leaving both files untouched for manual recovery?
rationale: This is a safe fail-closed implementation, but it introduces a new compatibility boundary for existing workspaces and no shipped root-memory size contract establishes that 8 MiB is always sufficient.

options.title: Keep the safe cutoff
options.body: Accept the 8 MiB limit, preserved-file behavior, and explicit diagnostic after current-head real behavior proof is posted.

options.title: Preserve automatic repair
options.body: Redesign the migration to stream or spool oversized content without unbounded buffering, then prove fresh-install and upgrade behavior.

recommendation.title: Keep the safe cutoff
recommendation.body: Accept the 8 MiB limit, preserved-file behavior, and explicit diagnostic after current-head real behavior proof is posted.

likelyOwner.reason: The root-memory doctor migration and archive semantics originate from their merged feature work.
